review_kind: bounded local static source review only

actual_route_proof.scope: Parent/owner original route proof, locally hashed; no native route execution by this reviewer.

disposition: No definite handwritten-server contract blocker to immutable table reuse, conditional on preserving the listed dynamic path and exact dependency traits/macro behavior. Candidate source, expansion and native verification have not been reviewed or executed.

findings.requirement: Read the current process runtime-config presence for every call/list and combine it with the current request tool name. Runtime mode hides shell; filesystem mode hides exactly RUNTIME_TOOL_NAMES. Retain unknown-tool canonicalization and exact-only metadata observer exemption.
findings.clarification: RUNTIME_CONFIG is process-global OnceLock, not per-OctofsServer mutable configuration. A pre-init to post-init transition is meaningful in an isolated child; two different installed runtime configurations in one process are not supported.

findings.requirement: Borrow immutable metadata for the selected current name, preserving canonical name and read_only_hint values.
findings.clarification: readonly is an audit failure-classification input, not an authorization switch. It does not itself permit or reject a write.

findings.requirement: Resolve the current instance owner_binding against this RequestContext on each admitted call; metadata observers still resolve inside their own handler. HTTP request Parts must carry AuthenticatedOperatorScope or fail; no fallback for untrusted HTTP headers. Reject changed authority within one session. Native fallback remains this instance search_owner; operation crypto remains current trusted HTTP extension or this instance stdio scope. No owner, crypto, capabilities or authorization result in a shared route entry.

Keep audit admission and request_status/request_result read-target validation under the current owner before dispatch. Keep result-intent admission and refusal identity/ack behavior. Hidden and unknown routes retain ordinary audit admission when runtime is enabled; exact metadata observers alone skip it.

Construct ToolCallContext from the current self, request and context for each call. Keep session root/current workdir and first-capability application, per-instance view cache, fresh task-local hints, current peer/progress token/protocol and subscription registry. Distinct with_root instances remain isolated; Clone intentionally shares the original session Arc state.

Retain existing handler-body current local/remote path and backend policy checks and new-effect admission. Existing continuation/local-state exceptions and direct-native ingress fencing remain unchanged. Do not pre-authorize a handler or store an admission permit in the router.

Retain this request cancellation token, result, audit ticket and result intent. Cancellation => Unknown; successful complete response => Completed; invisible or readonly errors => Failed; remaining errors => Unknown. Keep result retention, current request identity, final wire budget, audit finish and durability acknowledgements; no automatic replay on audit finish failure.

list_tools must filter current runtime mode, transform a cloned returned Tool and a cloned schema map, and put a new Arc only in that returned descriptor. Never mutate the shared raw Tool/schema. Keep per-context protocol hints: modern ttl0/public, legacy absent. Do not cache the whole ListToolsResult across protocol/mode states.

Only the compiled table and static descriptors are cache candidates. Current71 tool declarations use literal title/description and4 boolean annotation values, with no name/schema expression overrides. Seven schema_with uses target one fixed literal JSON callback; remaining schemars attributes are required and max50. No repository manual JsonSchema impl was found by the bounded source scan.
findings.limitation: Source review does not prove external macro/derive behavior or Send+Sync, and is not Cargo expansion or native compilation. Exact dependency reviewer owns those constraints.

minimal_regression_work.change: Extend the existing isolated-child runtime metadata observer test rather than adding a separate heavy campaign. Warm discovery through real MCP before init_runtime, assert runtime tool unavailable then, install the existing offline fixture, and verify runtime discovery/host_list work while shell is hidden and refuses. Keep existing exact-observer/unknown-route archive assertions. Add a second independently constructed server/client: A has one host_list admission, B usage/history remain empty until B calls host_list, then counts and identities remain per owner on interleaved calls.
minimal_regression_work.risk_resolved: No first-call mode/owner/audit-result capture; hidden/unknown handling still takes current request path.
minimal_regression_work.constraints: Use a fresh child because config is global OnceLock. Do not replace config or use remote hosts. Keep constructor-distinct servers; clones intentionally share a session.

minimal_regression_work.change: One real-duplex two-server fixture with different local roots and the same relative filename containing different markers. Interleave view calls, change workdir only on A, and show B still resolves its own root and receives its own first full view. Warm the shared table before both calls; modest concurrent calls can exercise current self/context.
minimal_regression_work.risk_resolved: Current self/workdir/view cache are supplied at dispatch, not bound to first initializer.
minimal_regression_work.constraints: Use local temporary fixtures only. Avoid shell timing or network dependencies. This is behavioral isolation, not pointer-equality or repeated accessor tests.

minimal_regression_work.change: Extend served_tool_schemas_carry_no_generator_noise: snapshot raw descriptors from the shared router by tool name, perform repeated actual list_tools calls, assert expected cleaned returned schemas and that raw shared metadata/schemas still equal the snapshot. Normalize by name instead of HashMap iteration order. Reuse existing protocol-hint tests.
minimal_regression_work.risk_resolved: Discovery does not mutate globally shared schemas or cache a protocol-specific result.
minimal_regression_work.constraints: Snapshot the shared router, not a newly generated factory; otherwise a mutation could escape detection. No need for dozens of copied schema tests.
